title: Polynomial bound for the split-body running time
statement: Let $C,e,l,n,T$ be natural numbers. If $l\\le n+1$ and $T\\le (C+1+5e)(l+1)^e+1$, then $T+5l+3n+20\\le ((C+1+5e)2^e+40)(n+1)^{e+1}$.
